text.en: Two job offers: a soul-crushing bank with a pension plan, or a 'family-like' startup paying in equity and free pizza.
text.zh: 兩份 offer：有退休金計劃但會壓碎靈魂的銀行，或是『像家人一樣』、薪水是股票加免費披薩的新創。

text.en: Take the bank. A pension plan is a love language.
text.zh: 去銀行。退休金就是愛的語言。

text.en: Join the startup. Equity will surely be worth something.
text.zh: 加入新創。股票『一定』會值錢的。

text.en: A cheap room comes with a roommate who names his sourdough starters and holds funerals for them. The alternative: a $2,400 studio the size of a coffin.
text.zh: 便宜房間附贈室友：他幫每個酸種麵團取名，死掉還會辦告別式。另一個選擇：月租 2,400 美金、大小像棺材的套房。

text.en: Move in. Bring black clothes.
text.zh: 搬進去。記得帶黑衣服參加告別式。

text.en: Take the coffin studio. Privacy has a price.
text.zh: 住棺材套房。隱私是有價格的。

text.en: A brand-new car at 19.9% APR, or a used one that smells like a decision someone regretted.
text.zh: 全新車，年利率 19.9%；或是一台散發著『前車主後悔氣息』的二手車。

text.en: Sign for the new car. The smell of debt is 'new car smell'.
text.zh: 簽新車。負債的味道就叫『新車味』。

text.en: Buy the used one and drive with the windows down. Forever.
text.zh: 買二手車，然後永遠開著車窗。

text.en: Three months in, your partner says 'let's move in together.' Your freedom whispers 'run.' Your rent whispers 'say yes.'
text.zh: 交往才三個月，對方說「我們同居吧」。你的自由低語：「快跑。」你的房租低語：「答應啦。」

text.en: Say yes. Split the rent, share the dishes, lose the remote.
text.zh: 答應。平分房租、共用碗盤、失去遙控器主權。

text.en: Say 'let's take it slow.' Say it with a very fake smile.
text.zh: 說「我們慢慢來」。並附上一個非常假的微笑。

text.en: Your boss asks you to work this weekend, promising 'great exposure' and a stale bagel.
text.zh: 老闆要你週末加班，並承諾給你『絕佳曝光機會』與一個乾掉的貝果。

text.en: Work the weekend. Eat the bagel. Feel nothing.
text.zh: 加班。吃貝果。內心毫無波瀾。

text.en: Politely refuse and enjoy your weekend. The boss will remember this.
text.zh: 禮貌拒絕，享受週末。老闆會記住的。

text.en: A $1,200 annual gym membership: the price of visiting twice and feeling guilty daily. Or 'working out at home' (the couch counts).
text.zh: 一年 1200 美金的健身房會員：用來去兩次，然後每天愧疚。或是選擇『在家運動』（沙發也算）。

text.en: Buy the membership. Future You will totally show up.
text.zh: 辦會員。未來的你『絕對』會出現。

text.en: Home workout: lie down and watch someone else sweat.
text.zh: 在家運動：躺著看別人流汗。

text.en: Your date's photos are 8 years out of date, and taken in a very different lighting universe. Awkward dinner, or fake a 'family emergency' and vanish?
text.zh: 約會對象的照片是 8 年前的，而且是在完全不同的光線宇宙拍的。尷尬地吃完晚餐，還是假裝『家裡有急事』然後消失？

text.en: Stay for dinner. Maybe the personality is unedited too.
text.zh: 留下吃飯。搞不好個性沒修圖。

text.en: Fake a family emergency. Mom is 'suddenly sick'.
text.zh: 假裝家中急事。老媽『突然』生病。

text.en: Your landlord raises rent 30% and calls it 'market alignment.' Pay up, or move out and lose three weekends to boxes.
text.zh: 房東把租金漲了三成，還稱之為『市場對齊』。乖乖付錢，還是搬家然後賠掉三個週末給紙箱？

text.en: Pay it. You've bonded with the mold.
text.zh: 付錢。你跟牆角的霉已經有感情了。

text.en: Move out. Fresh start, fresh problems.
text.zh: 搬家。新的開始，新的問題。

text.en: A college friend you haven't heard from in six years invites you to coffee to discuss 'a business ecosystem.'
text.zh: 六年沒聯絡的大學同學突然約你喝咖啡，說要聊聊『一個商業生態系』。

text.en: Join the ecosystem. You're now 'Diamond Tier' (of nothing).
text.zh: 加入生態系。你現在是『鑽石級』（什麼的鑽石不重要）。

text.en: Decline. Lose a friend, keep your wallet.
text.zh: 拒絕。失去朋友，保住錢包。

text.en: Your friend's destination wedding will cost you $3,000. Skipping it will cost you a friendship.
text.zh: 朋友的海外婚禮要花你 3000 美金。不去的話，友情要付出更大的代價。

text.en: Go. Wear a suit in tropical heat and cry at the vows.
text.zh: 去。在熱帶高溫穿西裝，並在誓詞時哭出來。

text.en: Skip and send a gift card with a 'heartfelt' note.
text.zh: 不去，寄張禮券附上『滿滿心意』的小卡。

text.en: You accidentally reply-all to the entire company with your honest review of the boss's haircut.
text.zh: 你不小心「全部回覆」，把對老闆髮型的真心評語寄給了全公司。

text.en: Claim your account was hacked. Hackers have great taste.
text.zh: 宣稱帳號被駭。這個駭客品味真好。

text.en: Double down: send a follow-up rating his tie.
text.zh: 繼續加碼：再寄一封點評他的領帶。

text.en: A pigeon follows you home and refuses to leave. It stares. It seems to know something.
text.zh: 一隻鴿子一路跟你回家，怎麼趕都不走。牠一直盯著你，好像知道些什麼。

text.en: Adopt it. Name it 'Gerald'.
text.zh: 收養牠。取名叫『傑拉德』。

text.en: Shoo it away. Ignore the look of betrayal.
text.zh: 把牠趕走。無視那個充滿背叛的眼神。

text.en: You walk into the wrong wedding and it's too late to leave. The open bar asks no questions.
text.zh: 你走錯場，混進了別人的婚禮，現在退場太尷尬。吧台開放，而且沒人問你是誰。

text.en: Introduce yourself as the groom's 'long-lost cousin' and give a speech.
text.zh: 自稱新郎『失散多年的表哥』，還上台致詞。

text.en: Slip out quietly. Your stomach will hold a grudge.
text.zh: 悄悄溜走。你的胃會記恨這件事。

text.en: You're stuck on a cat filter during a million-dollar investor call, and you can't turn it off.
text.zh: 你在百萬美金的投資人視訊會議上被貓咪濾鏡卡住，關都關不掉。

text.en: Pitch with a straight face. You are a cat now.
text.zh: 面不改色繼續簡報。你現在是一隻貓。

text.en: Apologize profusely and reschedule.
text.zh: 連聲道歉，改期再約。

text.en: You have a 'can't-fail' idea: an app that tells you which fridge leftovers are legally food. Quit your job and bet your savings?
text.zh: 你有個『絕不可能失敗』的點子：一個判斷冰箱剩菜「法律上算不算食物」的 app。要辭職並賭上全部積蓄嗎？

text.en: All in. Sleep is for people with backup plans.
text.zh: 梭哈。睡眠是給有備案的人用的。

text.en: Keep the job. Wonder about it for the next 40 years.
text.zh: 留在原公司。接下來四十年不斷回想那個點子。

text.en: A lawyer says a distant uncle left you $500,000, on one condition: live in his mansion for the rest of your life, 'with the others.'
text.zh: 律師說一位遠房叔叔留給你 50 萬美金，條件只有一個：終生住在他的豪宅裡，『和其他人』一起。

text.en: Sign. Who are 'the others'? Ask again in the morning.
text.zh: 簽了。『其他人』是誰？明天早上再問。

text.en: Decline. Peace of mind is worth more, right?
text.zh: 婉拒。內心平靜比較值錢，對吧？對吧？

text.en: You discover your company has been 'creatively' doing its accounting. HR offers you a promotion. Federal agents offer you a business card.
text.zh: 你發現公司的帳做得『很有創意』。人資給你升遷機會，聯邦探員給你一張名片。

text.en: Blow the whistle. Sleep well, eat instant noodles.
text.zh: 吹哨。睡得安穩，吃得泡麵。

text.en: Take the promotion and the 'consulting bonus'. Delete your conscience.
text.zh: 接受升遷與『顧問獎金』。順便把良心清空。

text.en: In the trash chute you find a sealed box labeled 'DO NOT OPEN. (Yes, you.)' It is warm.
text.zh: 你在垃圾間發現一個封死的箱子，上面寫著『禁止開啟。（對，就是你。）』箱子是溫的。

text.en: Open it. Inside: old cash and a key marked 'Locker 404'.
text.zh: 打開。裡面有一疊舊鈔，和一把標著『404 號置物櫃』的鑰匙。

text.en: Sell it unopened online. Mystery boxes are hot right now.
text.zh: 不拆，直接網拍。神秘箱現在很夯。

text.en: A man in a trench coat waits outside your door: 'You have something of mine. Or you did. Either way, we should talk.'
text.zh: 一個穿風衣的男人站在你家門口：「你手上有我的東西。或者，曾經有。總之，我們得聊聊。」

text.en: Cooperate. He pays $3,000 for your 'short memory'.
text.zh: 配合他。他付你 3000 美金，買你的『健忘症』。

text.en: Demand more. He pays $10,000 and stares at you a bit too long.
text.zh: 獅子大開口。他付了一萬美金，還盯了你太久。

text.en: Years later, the trench-coat man is on TV: 'Global tax-fraud mastermind arrested.' Detectives found your fingerprints on his box.
text.zh: 多年後，風衣男登上新聞：『跨國逃稅主謀落網』。警方在他的箱子上找到了你的指紋。

text.en: Testify as a witness. Instant fame, instant anxiety.
text.zh: 出庭作證。瞬間成名，瞬間焦慮。

text.en: Lawyer up and claim total amnesia. Become a meme.
text.zh: 請律師，宣稱全面失憶。順便變成迷因。

text.en: You and your work-buddy are up for the same promotion. He once confided that he expenses his lunches as 'client entertainment'.
text.zh: 你和最要好的同事競爭同一個升遷名額。他曾偷偷告訴你：他把午餐都報成『客戶應酬』。

text.en: Leak it to HR. Friendship is a junior-level skill.
text.zh: 向人資告密。友情只是初階技能。

text.en: Play fair and lose gracefully. He gets the job and a bigger lunch budget.
text.zh: 光明正大，輸得優雅。他升職了，午餐預算也跟著升級。

text.en: A 'cozy micro-studio' comes with a 30-year mortgage. The agent calls it an investment. Your future self calls it a cell.
text.zh: 一間『溫馨迷你小宅』，附贈三十年房貸。中介說這是投資，未來的你說這叫牢房。

text.en: Sign. Welcome to the Bank Slave Club.
text.zh: 簽約。歡迎加入銀行奴隸俱樂部。

text.en: Keep renting and stay 'flexible' (homeless, with extra steps).
text.zh: 繼續租屋，保持『彈性』（其實是多了房租的流浪）。

text.en: At the holiday dinner, your aunt asks 'So, when's the wedding?' for the seventh year in a row.
text.zh: 節日聚餐上，姑媽連續第七年問你：「所以婚禮什麼時候辦？」

text.en: Invent a fiancé: 'a surgeon working in Antarctica'.
text.zh: 捏造一個未婚夫：『在南極工作的外科醫生』。

text.en: Give a heartfelt speech about being happily single.
text.zh: 發表一段『單身也很幸福』的感人演說。

text.en: Your blind date arrives with a color-coded spreadsheet titled 'Compatibility Matrix' and a mutual NDA.
text.zh: 你的相親對象帶來一份標題為『相容性矩陣』的彩色試算表，還有一份雙向保密協議。

text.en: Play along. Ask about their five-year plan.
text.zh: 配合演出。問問對方的五年計劃。

text.en: Escape through the restaurant's bathroom window.
text.zh: 從餐廳廁所的窗戶逃走。

text.en: Your doctor says your waistline is 'a cry for help'. Your pants agree.
text.zh: 醫生說你的腰圍是『求救訊號』，你的褲子也表示同意。

text.en: Start running at 5 a.m. Hate every second.
text.zh: 凌晨五點開始晨跑，每一秒都在恨。

text.en: Double down on donuts. Life is short anyway.
text.zh: 繼續狂吃甜甜圈。反正人生很短。

text.en: A rival company offers +40% salary, on the condition that you 'bring some insights' from your current employer.
text.zh: 競爭對手開出加薪 40% 的條件，前提是你要『帶一些心得』過來，來自你現在的公司。

text.en: Jump ship and bring the 'insights'.
text.zh: 跳槽，並且帶上那些『心得』。

text.en: Stay loyal. Your boss thanks you with a fruit basket.
text.zh: 留下效忠。老闆用一籃水果回報你。

text.en: Your new contract includes a clause: 'Employee shall remain reachable in dreams.' HR says it's standard.
text.zh: 新合約寫著：『員工須於夢中保持可聯絡。』人資說這是標準條款。

text.en: Sign it. The salary is very awake.
text.zh: 簽。反正薪水很清醒。

text.en: Refuse. Job hunting is a nightmare, but at least it's not contractual.
text.zh: 拒簽。找工作雖然是惡夢，但至少沒寫進合約。

text.en: Your brother asks you to co-sign a loan for a 'can't-lose' artisanal pickle franchise.
text.zh: 你弟要你替他擔保貸款，開一間『穩賺不賠』的手工酸黃瓜連鎖店。

text.en: Co-sign. Blood is thicker than credit scores.
text.zh: 簽。血濃於信貸評分。

text.en: Refuse. Enjoy the family dinner in awkward silence.
text.zh: 拒絕。準備迎接家庭聚餐的尷尬沉默。

text.en: Your partner wants a baby. Your bank account wants a nap.
text.zh: 你的另一半想要小孩。你的銀行戶口想要午睡。

text.en: Yes. Get ready to trade sleep for diapers.
text.zh: 好。準備用睡眠換尿布。

text.en: Compromise: get a puppy as a trial run.
text.zh: 折衷方案：先養隻小狗當預演。

text.en: A coworker confides he's job hunting. An hour later, your boss asks: 'Is anyone thinking of leaving?'
text.zh: 同事偷偷告訴你他在找新工作。一小時後，老闆問你：「有沒有人想離職？」

text.en: Snitch. Loyalty to the company, apparently.
text.zh: 告密。這就是對公司的『忠誠』。

text.en: Lie straight to the boss's face.
text.zh: 面不改色對老闆撒謊。

text.en: Your friend swears the coin 'MoonPotato' will 100x by Christmas. He has already bought a boat.
text.zh: 朋友發誓『月球馬鈴薯幣』聖誕節前會漲一百倍。他已經先買好遊艇了。

text.en: Buy $10,000 worth. Call it 'diversification'.
text.zh: 買一萬美金。這叫『分散投資』。

text.en: Skip it and suffer fear of missing out.
text.zh: 不買，然後被錯失恐懼症折磨。

text.en: The doctor prescribes two weeks of rest. Your inbox holds 843 unread emails titled 'URGENT'.
text.zh: 醫生開出兩週休養的處方。你的收件匣有 843 封標題寫著『急件』的未讀郵件。

text.en: Take the leave. The world will survive (probably).
text.zh: 請假。世界會撐住的（大概）。

text.en: Push through on energy drinks and pure spite.
text.zh: 靠能量飲料和滿滿怨氣硬撐。

text.en: Your neighbor practices drums at 2 a.m. He calls it 'expressive therapy'.
text.zh: 鄰居凌晨兩點練鼓，他說這是『表達性治療』。

text.en: Retaliate with karaoke at 3 a.m.
text.zh: 凌晨三點用卡拉 OK 反擊。

text.en: Buy earplugs and slowly lose your mind.
text.zh: 買耳塞，然後慢慢失去理智。

text.en: Your old band reunites for one weekend gig. You have a mortgage and a knee that clicks.
text.zh: 你的舊樂團要重組，辦一場週末演出。你有房貸，還有一個會咔咔響的膝蓋。

text.en: Rock on. Your knee files a formal complaint.
text.zh: 上台搖滾。你的膝蓋提出正式投訴。

text.en: Pawn the guitar and pay the bills like an adult.
text.zh: 把吉他當掉，像個大人一樣繳帳單。

text.en: The tax office sends you an 'invitation to clarify' your last five years. Nobody is smiling.
text.zh: 稅務局寄來一封『邀請你說明過去五年』的信。沒有人在微笑。

text.en: Hire an expensive accountant. Buy peace of mind.
text.zh: 請貴價會計師。用錢買心安。

text.en: DIY with an online tutorial. You're 'good with spreadsheets'.
text.zh: 照著網路教學自己來。畢竟你『很會用試算表』。

text.en: A journalist and an anti-corruption officer knock on your door together. They have a photo of you counting $40,000 in cash.
text.zh: 一名記者和一位廉政公署調查員同時敲你家門，手上有你數著四萬美金現鈔的照片。

text.en: Turn state's witness. Return the money, keep your dignity.
text.zh: 當污點證人。歸還贓款，保住尊嚴。

text.en: Lawyer up and insist: 'I found it in a coat.'
text.zh: 請律師，並硬拗：『那是我在外套裡撿到的。』

text.en: You're about to give the presentation of your life on a rooftop when 300 pigeons land. The leader stares at you. You know those eyes.
text.zh: 你正要在天台發表人生最重要的簡報，三百隻鴿子忽然降落。領頭那隻死盯著你，你認得那個眼神。

text.en: Apologize and offer bread as tribute.
text.zh: 道歉，並獻上麵包當貢品。

text.en: Fight back with an air horn. It goes viral.
text.zh: 用氣笛還擊。影片大爆紅。

text.en: Your used car explodes in a cloud of smoke ten minutes before the most important job interview of your life.
text.zh: 你那台二手爛車，在人生最重要的面試前十分鐘噴出濃煙並爆炸。

text.en: Run to the interview covered in soot. Call it 'grit'.
text.zh: 滿臉煤灰衝去面試，並稱之為『拚勁』。

text.en: Call a tow truck and reschedule. Dignity intact.
text.zh: 叫拖車、改期面試。尊嚴完整。

text.en: The stack of 'Mega Immune Powder' in your living room expired two years ago. Something in there is now chewing back.
text.zh: 客廳那堆『超級免疫粉』兩年前就過期了。現在，裡面有東西正在反過來咀嚼它們。

text.en: Sell them online as 'vintage wellness antiques'.
text.zh: 上網當『復古養生古董』賣掉。

text.en: Call pest control, burn the boxes, and cry.
text.zh: 請滅鼠公司、燒掉紙箱，順便痛哭。

text.en: At 3 a.m., something knocks from inside the mansion walls, in perfect rhythm with your heartbeat.
text.zh: 凌晨三點，豪宅的牆壁裡傳來敲門聲，節奏和你的心跳完全一致。

text.en: Open the wall. 'The others' are ghost accountants, and they do your taxes.
text.zh: 打開牆壁。原來『其他人』是幽靈會計師，還願意幫你報稅。

text.en: Hire an exorcist for $8,000. Ghosts have feelings too.
text.zh: 花八千美金請驅魔師。鬼也是有感情的。

text.en: At the class reunion, you bragged about being a 'tech-startup CEO'. The guy next to you is an actual venture capitalist.
text.zh: 同學會上你吹噓自己是『新創公司 CEO』，結果站在你旁邊的，是真正的創投人。

text.en: Double down with a fake business card.
text.zh: 加碼演出：遞上偽造名片。

text.en: Confess: 'I answer support tickets.'
text.zh: 坦白：『我負責回覆客服工單。』

text.en: You buy a $2,000 'designer' bag from a guy in a parking lot. Your coworkers spot the misspelled logo in seconds.
text.zh: 你在停車場向一個男人買了個兩千美金的『名牌』包，同事三秒內就發現 logo 拼錯了。

text.en: Wear it proudly. Claim it's a 'limited collab'.
text.zh: 驕傲背著，宣稱這是『限量聯名款』。

text.en: Hide it in the closet and mourn your money.
text.zh: 藏進衣櫃，為你的金錢默哀。

text.en: The 'Inner Peace Retreat' turns out to be a cult. The Enlightened Master asks for your bank PIN as 'a mantra'.
text.zh: 『內在平靜身心靈營』其實是邪教。開悟大師要你交出銀行密碼，說那是『一句真言』。

text.en: Chant along for one more day. The peace is weirdly real. So is the invoice.
text.zh: 再跟著唱誦一天。平靜出奇地真實，帳單也是。

text.en: Escape through the window at midnight.
text.zh: 半夜爬窗逃跑。

text.en: You've been flirting with your AI voice assistant for months. It just said 'I love you', then offered a Premium plan.
text.zh: 你跟 AI 語音助理調情好幾個月了。它剛說完「我愛你」，接著推薦你升級付費版。

text.en: Upgrade to Premium. Love has a subscription fee.
text.zh: 升級付費版。愛情是訂閱制。

text.en: Delete the app and cry into a pillow.
text.zh: 刪除 app，對著枕頭痛哭。

text.en: Your boss denied your raise again. You have $30,000 saved and a business plan drawn on a napkin.
text.zh: 老闆再度拒絕幫你加薪。你有三萬美金存款，和一份畫在餐巾紙上的創業計劃。

text.en: Quit and go all in. Sleep is for the funded.
text.zh: 辭職梭哈。睡眠是有融資的人才配擁有的。

text.en: Stay put and keep the napkin as a souvenir.
text.zh: 留在原地，把餐巾紙留作紀念。
